SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       td.target_type,
       td.tax_id,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       cd.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
       a.standard_type,
       a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays AS ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary AS td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary AS cd ON a.molregno = cd.molregno
JOIN compound_structures AS cs ON cd.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293237'
  AND a.bao_endpoint = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cd.chembl_id ASC,
         ass.chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
